messages.content: I keep comparing my creator journey to people who blew up in a few months.
Those stories get amplified precisely because they're rare — that's what makes them shareable. What does your actual growth look like month to month, ignoring their timeline?
Slow but steady I guess, maybe 5-10% more followers each month.

That's genuinely solid, compounding growth like that adds up fast over a year even if it doesn't feel dramatic week to week. The overnight stories are survivorship bias — you don't see the thousands who tried the same shortcut and it didn't work.
That actually helps, I think I needed to hear that.
Good. Keep tracking your own trend line, not theirs — that's the only comparison that actually tells you anything useful.
